caseName: United States ex rel. Brensilber v. Bausch & Lomb Optical Co.
caseNameFull: United States ex rel. Brensilber v. Bausch & Lomb Optical Co.
attorneys: Mr. William Stanley, with whom Mr. Homer Cummings was on the brief, for petitioners. Mr. Whitney North Seymour for Bausch & Lomb Optical Co. et al.; and Mr. Raymond M. White for Carl Zeiss, Inc., — respondents. Solicitor General Fahy, Assistant Attorney General Shea, and Messrs. K. Norman Diamond and Robert L. Stern filed a brief on behalf of the United States, as amicus curiae, urging reversal.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

Judgment affirmed by ah equally divided Court.

Mr. Justice Jackson took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
